items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Fat Cat has a way of taping everything, and then later on when he puts out the album... I think that Fat Cat in the beginning, he would bring the musicians down there... and since that time, he's put out quite a few tapes.

ctx.x: Next, we come to your appearance at the December 1969 Manassas Festival. Here again, you appear with two groups.
Yeah. Well, as I said before, Fat Cat has a way of taping everything, and then later on when he puts out the album, you don't know what's going to be on it. But --
